meta.title: The smallest price the screen allows is a real quote
gaps: The available setup recipes create only one line item, so line 2 cannot be created or tested.
The vocabulary does not define the company's minimum allowed price or a way to set a bid price to that minimum.
No read-back fields are available for line total, line savings, reference price, or the price-times-quantity calculation.
The available indicator read-back can verify rank and best bidder, but cannot target line 2 or verify the requested pricing calculations.
